pr.title: fix(mcp): enforce 127.0.0.1 binds across the MCP fleet
pr.body:
Catalog URLs mix localhost and 127.0.0.1 (conport/dope-memory/serena/gptr on localhost) and container port publishes are unaudited. Diffs against the prior DMX-HYG-LOOPBACK-002 proof to avoid re-doing landed scope.

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Audit: build a server x bind matrix from compose.yml port publishes + catalog URLs; diff against the DMX-HYG-LOOPBACK-002 proof bundle; mark rows already done.
validation: Proof contains the matrix (server, publish spec, catalog URL, verdict) with prior-done rows excluded from the change set.

steps.task: Fix remaining binds (127.0.0.1: publish prefixes, catalog URL normalization) and regenerate client configs.
validation: `docker compose config` shows 127.0.0.1-prefixed publishes for all MCP ports; catalog drift check passes.
lsof spot-check on at least one running server shows loopback-only listening (evidence in proof).
